entries.claim: Tyme Bank Limited registered as a bank by the SARB Prudential Authority in September 2017; publicly launched February 2019 after a December 2018 soft launch
entries.source_ref: TymeBank Limited Basel Pillar III Disclosure as at 30 June 2025

entries.claim: Core banking uses Mambu cloud-native SaaS
Technology stack runs on AWS (~85% of systems) with Docker, WSO2 API management and Java

Debit cards issued at IDEMIA biometric self-service kiosks (partnership from December 2020) at Pick n Pay and Boxer stores; account and activated Visa card issued in about five minutes with an SA ID number
entries.source_ref: IDEMIA press release; Mambu case study

entries.claim: EveryDay Account has R0 monthly fee; ATM withdrawal about R10 per R1,000; card replacement about R70
entries.source_ref: TymeBank EveryDay account fee schedule (secondary summaries)

entries.claim: GoalSave is a tiered savings product with a standard rate of about 6.00% p.a. compounded monthly; TymeAdvance is an on-demand salary-linked advance auto-repaid on payday
entries.source_ref: GoalSave product page; TymeBank investor overview deck

entries.claim: FY2025 (year to 30 June 2025): customer base 11.6m (+21%), deposits R7.7bn (+22%), net advances R2.25bn (+17%)
entries.source_ref: Tyme Bank Limited Annual Financial Statements FY2025

entries.claim: African Rainbow Capital (Patrice Motsepe) holds roughly 40% after the December 2024 US$250m Series D led by Nubank at about US$1.5bn valuation; previously about 55.37% control
entries.source_ref: ARC / press reporting on Series D

entries.claim: Group operates across South Africa, the Philippines (GoTyme), Indonesia, Hong Kong and (planned) Vietnam; group customer count reported between ~17m and ~20m depending on date
entries.source_ref: TIME 100 Most Influential Companies 2025 (GoTyme); BusinessTech; vietnam.tyme.com

entries.claim: TymeBank South Africa does not operate a first-class loyalty/points currency; behavioural rewards are delivered as interest tiers and fee mechanics
entries.source_ref: TymeBank product pages (absence of a points programme)

entries.claim: Mobile app framework, authentication primitives, API endpoints and card tokenisation
entries.source_ref: pending REA extraction: rea analyze-javascript-application on TymeBank APK classes.dex / index.android.bundle; rea trace-network during onboarding

entries.claim: Exact GoalSave tier rates, TymeAdvance pricing, TymePOS merchant discount rate and Mambu module coverage
